# dom-to-image-more

- Version: 3.11.0
- Source: https://github.com/IDisposable/dom-to-image-more/tree/v3.11.0
- Bundled file: dist/dom-to-image-more.min.js, unmodified
- License: MIT, included in dom-to-image-more.LICENSE

The extension uses this local bundle to render selected comment DOM and open Shadow DOM. It does not load executable library code from a CDN at runtime.
